zh: 我觉得这部电影挺好看的。
old_en: In my opinion, this movie is quite enjoyable.
new_en: I think this movie is pretty good.

zh: 我觉得这家餐厅值得一去。
old_en: To me, this restaurant is worth a visit.
new_en: I think it's worth visiting this restaurant.

zh: 我觉得这家菜很好吃。
old_en: Personally, I find this food quite delicious.
new_en: I think this food tastes really good.

zh: 我觉得这个工作挺适合他的。
old_en: I think this job suits him well.
new_en: I think this job suits him well.

zh: 在我看来，这个职位更有挑战性。
old_en: In my opinion, that position is more challenging.
new_en: I think that position is more challenging.

zh: 我觉得孩子早点睡觉对身体好。
old_en: I believe it’s better for kids to go to bed early for their health.
new_en: I think kids should go to bed early for their health.

zh: 我觉得去公园比较好，空气新鲜。
old_en: In my opinion, going to the park is better because the air is fresher.
new_en: I think going to the park is better because the air is fresher.

zh: 我觉得在家附近玩更好，方便。
old_en: To me, playing nearby is better since it’s more convenient.
new_en: I think playing nearby is better because it's more convenient.

zh: 我觉得网购更方便，不用出门。
old_en: I think online shopping is more convenient; you don’t have to go out.
new_en: I think online shopping is more convenient because you don't have to go out.

zh: 我觉得新地方更有发展潜力。
old_en: In my opinion, the new place has more potential for growth.
new_en: I think the new place has more potential.

zh: 新地方交通便利，我觉得搬到那里更好。
old_en: Personally, I think moving to the new place is better because of the convenient transportation.
new_en: The new place has convenient transportation, so I think moving there is better.

zh: 我觉得学开车不容易，要经常练习。
old_en: I think learning to drive is not easy; you need to practice often.
new_en: I think learning to drive is hard and you need to practice a lot.

zh: 我觉得养猫比养狗好照顾。
old_en: To me, I think keeping cats is easier than dogs.
new_en: I think cats are easier to take care of than dogs.

zh: 在我看来，养狗需要更多时间和精力。
old_en: In my opinion, owning dogs requires more time and effort.
new_en: To me, owning dogs needs more time and effort.

zh: 我觉得早起有助于一天都保持清醒。
old_en: Personally, I think getting up early helps stay alert all day.
new_en: I think getting up early helps you stay alert all day.

zh: 我觉得这部电影很感人。
old_en: I think this movie is very touching.
new_en: I think this movie is very touching.

zh: 这家餐厅的菜不错，我觉得值得推荐。
old_en: In my opinion, I think the food here is good and worth recommending.
new_en: I think the food here is good and worth recommending.

zh: 我觉得这家公司的福利比较好。
old_en: To me, I think this company's benefits are better.
new_en: I think this company's benefits are pretty good.

zh: 在我们家，我觉得早点睡觉有助于孩子更好地学习。
old_en: In my opinion, going to bed early helps kids study better.
new_en: In our family, I think going to bed early helps kids study better.

zh: 新公司的工作环境我觉得更好一些。
old_en: Personally, I think the work environment at the new company is better.
new_en: I think the work environment at the new company is better.
